page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 12 physical cores and 12 vCPUs, indicating a 1:1 mapping with no hyperthreading. It is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation offers predictable performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable instances. The balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes the ecs.g8i.3xlarge suitable for general-purpose workloads. These workloads include web serving, application servers, enterprise applications, and moderate database hosting where dedicated CPU resources are required but specialized GPU acceleration or high-speed local NVMe storage is unnecessary.
